_readme: TEMPLATE — not a fixture. reason-fixtures.mjs skips every file whose name starts with '_'.
A fixture is one FROZEN PAGE STATE plus the question a stuck person asked from it. The whole
point is that `snapshot` is LIFTED from a real page, never typed by hand: `filled`, `valid` and
`invalidReason` come from the live constraint-validation API, and the widget deliberately OMITS
`valid` where a control has no machine-checkable constraint. A hand-authored snapshot encodes
what we imagine a page reports, which is the one thing a regression fixture must not do.
To capture: embed the widget with data-flowbuddy-debug="true", put the page in the state you
want, ask a diagnostic question, then read window.FlowBuddyLastAsk in the console. Copy
context.reason.snapshot into `snapshot` and context.reason.trigger into `trigger`. The full
recipe, including which four states to capture, is in docs/ops/e2e-testing.md.
Do NOT paste context.sense's ids into this file. Name the workflow instead (see `workflow`):
ids change on every reseed, and a fixture holding stale ids keeps reporting a rate while
silently testing an unlocalized version of the engine.
label: Signup form, nothing filled in
question: why can't I create the account?

workflow._readme: Resolved to live ids at run time via GET /v1/copilot/sense-plan. Title must match the approved workflow EXACTLY; no match = the row is reported INVALID and never scored.
workflow.title: Create an account

snapshot._readme: Paste window.FlowBuddyLastAsk.context.reason.snapshot here, verbatim. The shape below is illustrative only.

texts: Password must be at least 8 characters

_readme: Every field is optional. Omitted = not asserted. Rates are reported per assertion, never
pass/fail — the model is non-deterministic and a binary would flap.
The plain-language check (no leaked constraint names / flag words / 'page state') is ALWAYS
on and needs no declaration: it is a rule for every answer the diagnostic engine ever gives.
covered           — true asserts it diagnosed rather than declined. The rule it guards is
'never conclude everything looks fine, and never decline, from structure
alone'. Set false only for a fixture where declining IS correct.
coversAllBlockers — defaults ON. Asserts the answer names every machine-checked blocker the
server computed (the prompt calls that list exhaustive and says the answer
MUST cover it). Set false where the fixture has no form blockers.
mustMention       — case-insensitive substrings the diagnosis has to contain. Use for the
fixture's actual cause, e.g. a rejection banner's meaning.
mustNotMention    — extra forbidden strings on top of the always-on vocabulary check.
tools.required    — tool calls that must have RUN, e.g. get_page_image for a fixture whose
blocker is only visible in pixels ('look at the image BEFORE hedging').
tools.forbidden   — tool calls that must NOT have run, e.g. asserting a cheap fixture stays
cheap ('call a tool ONLY when it would change the diagnosis').
